events.event_hazard: Nuclear disaster (radiological release) triggered by earthquake and tsunami
key_impacts: Melted nuclear fuel remains in reactors; continuous cooling is required to prevent further radioactive release.
Coolant water becomes extremely contaminated and leaks into reactor building basements.
Approximately 400 tons of groundwater flow into the site daily, contributing to contaminated water accumulation.
The site is packed with 1,000-ton capacity tanks of contaminated water; the unstable ground risks tanks toppling.
Communities in Japan continue to bear the damage from the large-scale nuclear disaster.
